ALTER VIEW [DW].[ViewCustomerAccountProduct] 
AS 
WITH Base AS (
	SELECT
		DC.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
		,DC.CustomerID AS CustomerID
		,DC.GlobalCIF AS GlobalCIF
		,DC.FCBSCIF AS FCBSCIF
		,DC.BankSK AS BankSK
		,DC.SourceSystemCode AS CustomerSourceSystemCode
		,DCA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
		,DCA.AccountID AS AccountID
		,DA.AccountOpenedDate AS AccountOpenedDate
		,CA.CustomerAccountClosedDate AS AccountClosedDate
		,DA.AccountStatus AS AccountStatus
		,DCA.SourceSystemCode AS AccountSourceSystemCode
		,DAP.ProductSK AS ProductSK
		,DAP.ProductID AS ProductID
		,DP.ProductName AS ProductName
		,DP.ProductGroup AS ProductGroup
		,DAP.CurrentIndicator AS CurrentIndicator
		,DAP.ValidStartDate AS ValidStartDate
		,DAP.ValidEndDate AS ValidEndDate
		,0 AS WorkFlowID
		,0 AS TaskRunID
		,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm
	FROM DW.DimCustomer DC
	LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount DCA
		ON DC.CustomerSK = DCA.CustomerSK
	LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DA
		ON DC.CustomerSK = DCA.CustomerSK
		AND DCA.AccountSK = DA.AccountSK
	LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccount CA
		ON DC.CustomerSK = DCA.CustomerSK
		AND DCA.AccountID = CA.CustomerAccountID
	LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccountProduct DAP
		ON DC.CustomerSK = DCA.CustomerSK
		AND DCA.AccountSK = DAP.AccountSK
	LEFT JOIN DW.DimProduct DP
		ON DC.CustomerSK = DCA.CustomerSK
		AND DCA.AccountSK = DAP.AccountSK
		AND DAP.ProductSK = DP.ProductSK
	WHERE DC.CurrentIndicator = 1
		AND DCA.CurrentIndicator = 1
		AND DA.CurrentIndicator = 1
		AND DAP.CurrentIndicator = 1
		AND DP.CurrentIndicator = 1
)
, Cascade_FCBS AS (
	SELECT
    A.CustomerSK,A.CustomerID,A.GlobalCIF,A.FCBSCIF,A.BankSK,A.CustomerSourceSystemCode,B.AccountSK
    ,B.AccountID,B.AccountOpenedDate,B.AccountClosedDate,B.AccountStatus,B.AccountSourceSystemCode,B.ProductSK,B.ProductID,B.ProductName
    ,B.ProductGroup,B.CurrentIndicator,B.ValidStartDate,B.ValidEndDate,B.WorkFlowID,B.TaskRunID,B.InsertDttm
    FROM Base A LEFT JOIN Base B ON A.FCBSCIF = B.FCBSCIF
	WHERE A.FCBSCIF IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
    A.CustomerSK,A.CustomerID,A.GlobalCIF,A.FCBSCIF,A.BankSK,A.CustomerSourceSystemCode,B.AccountSK
    ,B.AccountID,B.AccountOpenedDate,B.AccountClosedDate,B.AccountStatus,B.AccountSourceSystemCode,B.ProductSK,B.ProductID,B.ProductName
    ,B.ProductGroup,B.CurrentIndicator,B.ValidStartDate,B.ValidEndDate,B.WorkFlowID,B.TaskRunID,B.InsertDttm
)
, Cascade_NoFCBS AS (
	SELECT *
    FROM Base
    WHERE FCBSCIF IS NULL
)
, Loans_Closed AS (
    SELECT AccountSK FROM DW.DimAccount
    WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1 AND SourceSystemCode = 'LNS' AND AccountStatus = 'Closed'
)

---SELECT TOP 10 * FROM Cascade_FCBS WHERE AccountSK NOT IN (SELECT * FROM Loans_Closed) AND FCBSCIF = 'R02020004'
SELECT * FROM Cascade_FCBS WHERE AccountSK NOT IN (SELECT * FROM Loans_Closed)
UNION
SELECT * FROM Cascade_NoFCBS WHERE AccountSK NOT IN (SELECT * FROM Loans_Closed)
---SELECT TOP 10 * FROM Cascade_NoFCBS WHERE AccountSK NOT IN (SELECT * FROM Loans_Closed) AND FCBSCIF = 'R02020004'
